Eye Pattern - Gradient Eyes.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Gradient Eyes
Irises that gradually shift from one color to another — a smooth transition between your primary and secondary eye colors.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Gradient Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Each iris transitions in a smooth gradient from one eye color at the pupil to the other at the outer edge. Apply gradient eyes using primary and secondary eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
